name: Arms, Neck & Core Specialisation (10 weeks)
description: Specialisation block: arms, forearms and grip, shoulders and traps, neck (Thibarmy Intermediate then Advanced) and core, with full body maintenance on machines at the office. Weeks 1-4 accumulation, 5-8 intensification (+1 set on priority lifts, neck Advanced, optional vest on pull-ups), week 9 deload, week 10 tests.

exercises.name: Banded neck protraction
instructions: Lie on a bench, band anchored under it and wrapped around the forehead (towel for comfort).
Start in full retraction (double chin). Drive the chin toward the ceiling, lifting head and neck off the bench.
Lower with control. Keep the forehead perpendicular to the band.

exercises.name: Banded neck retraction
instructions: Sit with the upper back supported, band looped behind the head and held in front of the face.
Start with the chin jutted forward. Pull the back of the head into the band, chin tucked, jaw parallel to the floor.
Return with control.

exercises.name: Gittleson shrug (one-arm, kettlebell)
instructions: Sit upright on a bench, wide stance, kettlebell in one hand, other hand holding the bench underneath.
Shrug as high as possible, keep elevating past where you think the top is, pause.
Lower under control. Do not move the neck on purpose; let it follow.

exercises.name: Bench neck flexion bridge
instructions: Kneel facing the long side of a bench, forehead and forearms on the pad, knees lifted so weight is on forefeet and forehead.
Start with chest dropped toward the floor (neck extended). Press the forehead into the pad and pull the chin to the chest, driving the mid back up.
Return by letting the neck extend. Use the forearms only as much as needed.

exercises.name: Bench neck extension bridge
instructions: Sit perpendicular to a bench, back of the head on the pad, knees over ankles, hips low.
Drive the back of the head into the pad and bridge the hips up while extending the neck, gaze behind you.
Lower until the head is about to lose purchase. Progress: hands on bench, then overhead, then across chest, then at sides.

exercises.name: Rice bucket: open and close
instructions: Hands buried in the rice. Open the fingers wide, then close into a fist. Fast and full range.

exercises.name: Rice bucket: wrist flexion and extension
instructions: Fists buried in the rice. Flex and extend the wrists against the resistance of the rice.

exercises.name: Rice bucket: pronation and supination
instructions: Hands buried, rotate palms up and palms down, twisting through the rice.

exercises.name: Rice bucket: finger dig and spread
instructions: Dig the fingers down into the rice like claws, then spread them apart against the resistance.

exercises.name: Rice bucket: wrist circles
instructions: Fists buried, draw circles with the wrists, both directions.

exercises.name: Suitcase carry (kettlebell)
instructions: Hold one heavy kettlebell at your side, stand tall, ribs down, shoulders level.
Walk without leaning toward or away from the weight. Switch sides.

exercises.name: Hollow body hold
instructions: Lie on your back, lower back pressed into the floor, arms overhead, legs straight and a few centimetres off the floor.
Hold. Regress by bending the knees or bringing the arms forward.

exercises.name: Foam roller thoracic extension
instructions: Foam roller across the mid back, hands behind the head, hips down.
Extend the upper back over the roller, exhale, return. Move the roller up a few centimetres and repeat.

exercises.name: Quadruped thoracic rotation
instructions: On all fours, one hand behind the head. Rotate the elbow toward the opposite knee, then open up toward the ceiling, following with the eyes.

exercises.name: Leg swings (front to back and side to side)
instructions: Hold a support. Swing one leg front to back with control, then side to side. Switch legs.

exercises.name: Heavy bag round (Muay Thai technique)
instructions: Technique work on the heavy bag at a controlled pace: combinations, kicks, knees. Stay relaxed, focus on form.
